the inefficiency of hospitals in Sicilian regions is mostly due to congestion and that the congestion is statistically significant for hospital type and for the provinces.

congestion is an important source of inefficiency in hospitals, which is statistically different among hospital types and among provinces, and that congestion is related to the inefficiency of the health care system.
the overall inefficiency of the hospitals in Sicily is mainly attributable to the presence of congestion and to technical inefficiency.

a multidimensional evaluation of the efficiency of Sicilian hospitals, which considers the simultaneous occurrence of inefficiency and congestion.

the measurement and the analysis of inefficiencies of hospitals in terms of both technical efficiency and congestion, in order to provide useful information to decision makers in the health care field.
the evaluation of the impact of the inappropriateness of the health care organization and its effects on the efficiency evaluation.

a significant amount of inefficiencies could be eliminated by reducing the level of inappropriatenesses in the health care delivery process.

the congestion of hospitals in Sicilian health system is a relevant problem and should be considered in efficiency evaluation studies.
